name: Polarity integration

subjectOf.text: A maximally effective set of unifying values integrates opposing values rather than choosing between them, because the purpose of unification is to bring together individuals holding different perspectives.
subjectOf.abstract: The point of unifying people is to bring together individuals with different perspectives. A maximally effective set of unifying values will achieve the seemingly impossible feat of integrating opposing values.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Transcendental Unifying Values for Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782220

subjectOf.text: Building secure walls with well-designed doors is the proper way to embody conservative and liberal values together in an economic system: walls protect the group from the Tragedy of the Commons and malicious threats, while doors admit fresh input from anyone willing and able to help.
subjectOf.abstract: Building secure walls with well-designed doors is the proper way to embody both values, integrating them harmoniously in your economic system. You need to secure your system from ruin, build walls to protect your group from the Tragedy of the Commons and malicious threats.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Transcendental Unifying Values for Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782220
scope_conditions: economic systems needing both protection and renewal

subjectOf.text: The intuition that strengthening one pole of a value pair necessarily diminishes its opposite is plainly false in any complex situation.
subjectOf.abstract: Each pair of values is in tension with its opposite. It is natural to imagine that strengthening one diminishes its opposite. But that is plainly false in any complex sit- uation.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Transcendental Unifying Values for Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782220
